description: check() promises a typed answer, so when its own answer comes back malformed (a truth whose value is a string) the call raises ServerError (status 200, reason from the x-decisionnode-error header) instead of returning an UnknownAnswer. decide() with the same answer returns an UnknownAnswer; see responses/malformed-known-answers.

headers.x-decisionnode-error: question 'check': the answer could not be completed

fields.reason: question 'check': the answer could not be completed
